name: Number Roll
description: A metric rolls up like an odometer: each digit column spins to its value, lower digits travelling further, with velocity-based vertical motion blur.
move: A metric rolls up like an odometer: each digit column spins to its value, lower digits travelling further, with velocity-based vertical motion blur.
how: Deterministic seek(t). Each digit column is a clipped window on a 0–9×3 stack with feathered top and bottom. Position follows cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) over 2.1s, staggered 0.07s; the two lowest digits do an extra lap. A per-column SVG feGaussianBlur with stdDeviation "0 y" is sized from the per-frame travel and switched off at rest so the settled digits are crisp.
adapt: Set data-value on .num (digits and separators). The suffix (+) and label are plain DOM. Placeholder copy is generic; replace it with the product's words. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: All motion is a pure draw(t) inline in index.html. Mount the markup in the shot, call draw from the film's frame hook (or a GSAP onUpdate with the shot-local time), and keep the font-load wait before measuring.
caveats: Original implementation of the After Effects "Odometer / slot counter" idea; no AE preset files, expressions or numbers are copied and fidelity to a specific AE render is not claimed.
Starts and ends on an empty stage so it loops cleanly; trim the exit when the next shot cuts in.
